_comment: Agent-authored §3.2.1 narrative-prose pass over the GIIGNL 2026 Annual Report (liquefaction narrative pp.28-31, regasification narrative pp.48-52). Every forward-looking / status finding from the prose, triaged against the fresh GEM export and (for actionable items) web-verified against authoritative sources. These route to giignl_to_action with their target route. GIIGNL prose is NOT authoritative and is never auto-applied (SOP §3.8); each actionable item carries a verified non-GIIGNL corroborating source. Confidence: high = corroborated by primary/IR or 2+ independent sources; medium = single-origin detail or recent/contested. action_category drives the giignl_to_action routing.
_schema_optional_arrays: Two OPTIONAL arrays may be added to any finding to carry STRUCTURED owner-change and name-change (rename) data instead of burying it in prose_finding free-text. A finding without them behaves exactly as before. (1) owner_changes: [{ entity: str (the entity whose stake changes — e.g. 'Stonepeak'), action: 'acquire'|'divest'|'add'|'remove', pct: number|null (stake percentage, null if unstated), stake_of: str (what the pct is a stake OF — e.g. 'infrastructure company' or terminal name), counterparty: str (the other party — seller/buyer/partner), anchor: str (year or YYYY-MM the change anchors to), entity_lookup: 'pending'|'done' (whether entity_lookup.py has been run to confirm the entity isn't a duplicate) }]. Each owner_changes entry routes (a) a row into the entity_additions sheet — so the entity goes through the dup-check path, with the dup-check column set to 'RUN entity_lookup' when entity_lookup=='pending' — AND (b) a giignl_to_action row with action_category 'narrative_owner_delta'. (2) name_changes: [{ old: str (former name), new: str (current name), gem_field: str (target GEM column, typically 'OtherNames'), anchor: str (year the rename anchors to) }]. Each name_changes entry routes (a) a row into a NEW name_reconciliation sheet AND (b) a giignl_to_action row with action_category 'narrative_name_delta'. Both arrays reuse the finding's citation; nothing is auto-applied (§3.8) — these are routing candidates for the human gate.

Solid but inferential, hence medium confidence. findings.prose_finding: Snam's FSRU BW Singapore (170,000-cbm, moored ~8.5 km offshore Ravenna at the Petra platform on 28 Feb 2025) completed commissioning 28 Apr 2025 and entered commercial regasification operations in May 2025. Status flip construction -> operating confirmed. CAPACITY CONFLICT RESOLVED: the terminal's regasification capacity is 5 BILLION CUBIC METRES PER YEAR (Snam official + LNG Prime + Offshore Energy all state '5 billion cubic metres'). 5 bcm/yr converts to ~3.7 MTPA. Therefore GIIGNL's 3.7 (MTPA) and the 5.0 (bcm/yr) figure describe the SAME capacity. GEM's stored '5.0' is the bcm/yr value mislabeled as MTPA -- a units error. CORRECT MTPA = 3.7 (GIIGNL is right); GEM should carry 3.7 MTPA (= 5.0 bcm/yr), not 5.0 MTPA.

findings.site_name: Adriatic LNG Terminal (Rovigo / Porto Levante offshore GBS)
findings.prose_finding: Apparent conflict is a UNIT confusion, not a real discrepancy. Operator's official figure is a maximum AUTHORIZED regasification capacity of 9.6 BILLION CUBIC METERS per year (a 13% increase announced March 2022 from the original 8 bcm/y nameplate). 9.6 bcm/y converts to ~7.06 MTPA — which is EXACTLY GEM's CapacityinMtpa (7.06). So GEM's MTPA figure is CORRECT; the '9.6' in the flag is bcm/y, not MTPA. GIIGNL's ~7.7 MTPA / ~8 bcm reflects the OLDER pre-2022 8 bcm nameplate. NO correction to GEM's MTPA needed; if anything GEM could refresh the bcm/y field to 9.6 and note the 2022 uprate. A further +0.5 bcm/y expansion was in authorization (~2026).
findings.recommended_status_change: investigate -> NO MTPA change (GEM 7.06 MTPA = 9.6 bcm/y is correct); optionally refresh CapacityinBcm/y to 9.6 + anchor to 2022 uprate

(1) WRONG VESSEL: GEM names 'Energos Power' as the operating vessel, but Deutsche ReGas TERMINATED the Energos Power sublet charter in February 2025 (citing DET pricing). The currently deployed and only operating vessel at Mukran is the FSRU NEPTUNE (2009-built, 145,000-cbm, ~5 bcm/y send-out; 50% Hoegh Evi, sub-chartered from TotalEnergies). GEM Vessel 2 (also 'Energos Power' in raw export) is mothballed. (2) CAPACITY TOO HIGH: GEM Vessel 1 shows 9.92 MTPA (~13.5 bcm/y). The 13.5 bcm/y figure is the planned TWO-FSRU combined terminal capacity, not a single vessel; with only Neptune deployed, realistic single-vessel send-out is ~5 bcm/y (~3.7 MTPA). GEM has assigned the combined two-vessel capacity AND the terminated vessel's name to a single operating row. Correction: Vessel 1 vessel name -> Neptune; single-vessel capacity ~5 bcm/y (~3.7 MTPA). FSRU SYNC: vessel name + IMO must agree with carrier project — flag the Energos Power->Neptune reassignment.
